offering_description.value: Sells advertising space and campaigns on outdoor media networks: street furniture, transport (airports, metro, rail, buses) and billboards. Sells to advertisers and media agencies, and holds long-term concessions with cities, airports and transit authorities to install and operate the displays.

primary_services.value: outdoor advertising space sales; street furniture advertising; transport advertising (airports, metro, rail); billboard advertising; digital and programmatic out-of-home campaigns

customer_segment.value: B2B: advertisers, brands and media agencies buying advertising campaigns; B2G: cities, airports and transit authorities granting concessions and receiving fees or free street furniture

end_markets.value: advertising; media; retail and consumer brands; transportation; urban infrastructure

revenue_model.value: service fees: advertising campaign revenue from display space on street furniture, transport and billboard networks; project or contract: long-term concession contracts with cities, airports and transit operators

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates street furniture, billboards and transport displays, sells ad space to advertisers and agencies; service provider: media sales and urban services to municipalities and transport operators

geography_served.value: global: Over 80 countries, with large presence in Europe, Asia-Pacific, North America, China and Middle East and Africa

specialization.value: related lines: street furniture, transport and billboard advertising, all out-of-home media sold to advertisers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales teams selling to advertisers and media agencies; online: programmatic platforms selling digital out-of-home inventory; partners / resellers: media agencies and advertising networks

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: outdoor advertising and urban planning rules, public concession and tender rules, data privacy rules for digital displays

notes: Segment shares and country count are approximate.
